kind: default-off development observation, not performance acceptance
clock: Stopwatch monotonic timestamps; not the supplied simulation clock
overflow: retain first prefix, count all omitted iterations; no full-run percentiles inferred
allocation: owner thread only; excludes startup, report copies and serialization
phaseTimes: wall ticks including scheduling, synchronous IO/waits and diagnostic overhead; NOT CPU execution time
present: timestamp only after successful native Present return, even if later host validation fails
interval: across all successful returns, including skipped/faulted/recovered iterations; NOT physical display timing
editorRecovery: outside per-iteration samples; included in next Present return interval
playerRecovery: inside Recovery phase; also included in next Present return interval
failure: preserve completed and final faulted/stopped raw prefix
remaining: full regression and final same-source cohorts
